title: Best headphones I have ever owned
body: The noise cancellation is incredible. Battery lasts forever. Worth every penny.

title: Great sound, slightly heavy
body: Audio quality is top-notch. My only complaint is they get a bit heavy after a few hours.

title: So soft and comfortable
body: The organic cotton feels amazing. Already ordered more in different colors.

title: Beautiful craftsmanship
body: The leather quality is exceptional. Slim profile but holds everything I need.

title: Impressive speaker for the size
body: Took it camping and the waterproofing held up perfectly. Bass could be a bit deeper.
